title: Integrable galactic potentials beyond Stäckel: an analytic search
description: Analytic investigation (Morales-Ramis theory, direct methods for polynomial integrals, exact scale-free classification, second-order perturbation theory, Birkhoff normal form) of whether smooth axisymmetric galactic potentials with a spherical centre and a flattened envelope can carry a non-Staeckel third integral. Scripts, research note and results.
